name: Jamie Briggs I seek leave of the House to move the third reading immediately. Leave not granted. Tony Burke I move: That so much of standing and sessional orders be suspended as would prevent the Member for Watson moving immediately: That this House: condemns the Government for failing to allow proper debate on legislation before the Parliament. We are in the middle of a debate on important legislation about infrastructure— Bronwyn Bishop I call the Leader of the House. Tony Burke and the cowardice of the Leader of the House— Christopher Pyne I move: That the Member be no longer heard. Bronwyn Bishop The question is that the member be no longer heard.
